optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform
professionalSummary: Seasoned AWS cloud engineer with two years of experience managing multi-account environments for a retail bank’s contact‑centre platform, including quota management, tagging, and CMDB inventory upkeep. Demonstrated calm incident response under pressure, having served on the on‑call rota for nine months and led the June chat‑service outage resolution. Proven track record of conducting monthly capacity and cost reviews, proposing right‑sizing initiatives, and maintaining comprehensive runbooks and post‑incident documentation.
experienceHighlights: Managed three AWS accounts, handled quota requests, and enforced tagging policies for telephony and chat services, ensuring up‑to‑date CMDB inventory after each change window.

Served on the platform on‑call rota for nine months; first responder to the June chat‑service outage, identified NAT gateway quota exhaustion, applied quota increase, and provided status updates every fifteen minutes until service restoration.
Authored the post‑incident review for the June outage, detailing timeline, root cause, and follow‑up actions, which received approval from the platform lead and acceptance by operations.
Conducted monthly capacity and cost reviews with the platform lead, proposing right‑sizing of chat‑service instances, documenting expected savings and rollback procedures in the change record.
Maintained account administration, on‑call incident response, capacity reviews, and runbook updates for the contact‑centre platform over two years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: June outage post‑incident review (timeline, root cause, actions, approvals) and chat‑service runbook section on quota exhaustion, with ticketing system audit history as verification.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample evidence establish the candidate’s experience in AWS account management, on‑call incident handling, capacity reviews, and runbook maintenance for a contact‑centre platform. The interview notes indicate potential confidence issues under pressure, but no direct evidence of performance in high‑stress scenarios beyond the documented outage response.

role.roleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform

evidence.text: Managed the platform's three AWS accounts, quota requests and the tagging policy for the telephony and chat services, keeping the resource inventory current in the CMDB after each change window.
Responsibilities included account administration, on-call incident response, capacity reviews and runbook maintenance for the contact-centre platform over two years.

Served on the platform on-call rota for nine months and handled the June chat-service outage as first responder: paged at 07:40, identified the exhausted NAT gateway allocation, applied the quota increase and posted status updates to contact-centre operations every fifteen minutes until service was restored at 08:55.
Wrote the post-incident review for the June outage, including the timeline, the missed capacity alarm and the follow-up actions, which the platform lead approved and the operations team accepted.

Ran the monthly capacity and cost review with the platform lead, proposing right-sizing of the chat-service instances with the expected monthly saving and the rollback path documented in the change record.
